Hi, from
Houghtons Bush!
Welcome to Houghtons Bush Camp. Set on a beautiful three-acre site, you can find us in the coastal community of Muriwai Beach. We’re only 50 minutes drive from downtown Auckland, and our campgrounds are surrounded by stunning native forest. Whatever your group’s requirements, we offer affordable accommodation and a wide range of outdoor activities.
A Wide Range of Local Attractions
While you’re staying with us, why not take in some of the local sites? From the wild black-sand of Muriwai Beach and its fascinating gannet colony, to the 18-hole golf course and nearby hot pools and adventure attractions, there’s no shortage of local destinations to complement your onsite programme. A popular pastime here is taking the opportunity to hike on tracks through native bush and forest - walks during which you can also view historic Maori kumara pits.
We’re centrally-located for all your accommodation needs
When you stay with us, your group has exclusive and full use of our entire site for the duration of your stay - we can cater for groups of up to 86 people. If you already live in Tāmaki Makaurau, Auckland, and you’re looking for a genuine outdoor experience close to home, we’ve got you covered. Because we’re only 15 minutes from Kumeu, living locally makes it easier to source close-by specialists and helpers to support the outdoor programmes you and your group want to take part in while you’re with us. Alternatively, if you’re visiting Auckland, why not stay at camp? Our facilities provide a handy, economical base from which to explore the city’s attractions.
Our Facilities
Clean, comfortable and well-maintained, the physical environment at Houghtons Bush provides a perfect balance between creature comforts and the essential outdoor camping experience.
From the commercial-style kitchen and spacious indoor areas, to the sheltered barbecue courtyard and challenging adventure courses, everything is designed to ensure your visit provides everyone with an experience they’ll cherish for life.
View our Facilities
Activities Anyone?
We offer lots of fun team building activities, including everything from orienteering courses to paintball, horse treks and an adventure playground. Depending on your requirements, you can prepare your own meals in our commercial-style kitchen, as well as make full use of the onsite activities we offer. Alternatively, you can hire caterers and utilise adventure operators to oversee your activities.
View our Activities
“I’d like to say thank you to you and your team for making the stay of over 80 people during the Queen's Birthday weekend in Houghtons Bush camp in Muriwai such a breeze to organise. I received several compliments, and no complaints!, about your facilities. It’s been very good working with you and your team!”
Annemarie Hogenbirk
Secretary North West Orienteering Club
“ We thoroughly enjoyed the campsite. It never disappoints. The caretakers were friendly, and clear about how and what they expected of us! And we like that. They were very respectful of our space.  We appreciate your efforts in helping us, and we’ll definitely be in contact if and when we need a campsite in the future. Thank you so much.”
Vanya - Faithful Unity Christian Fellowship
We had a fantastic time at Houghton's Bush Camp. The facilities were excellent and the layout of the camp made both parents and our first time campers feel very secure (horseshoe). The bush walk was well worth it - great views and the children loved climbing around the rocks to get up there after visiting the gannets. Our 'Camp Fire' was made from torches due to the fire ban but the set up for this is lovely and cosy - the wooden logs to sit on make it all very authentic.
Helen Martin, Kohia Terrace School
Our beautiful site nestled in the bush

pages.text:
FAQs - Houghton's Bush Camp Skip to content Frequently Asked Questions
Here are a few of our commonly asked questions, if you have additional questions please contact us, we'd be happy to answer them for you.
What do we need to bring?
Your own bedding including bottom sheet/sleeping bag/blanket/pillow/toiletries/medication. Your own cup/plate/bowl and cutlery. Dishwashing liquid/brushes/tea towels for hand washing (we do have a commercial dishwasher & cleaning liquid for use also)
What activities do you have on site?
Our field provides plenty of space to play and use our equipment provided such as cricket/volley ball/soft ball/tug of war rope/football/rugby. We have a basketball hoop and indoor ping pong table (equipment provided). Adventure playground for students over 9yrs of age and junior playground for those under 9yrs. Three bush walks, orienteering and a burma trail.
Do you charge for day visitors and what is the cost? FAQ
Day visitors who are at the camp for more than 2 hours are charged $25.
Can I do a site visit prior to booking?
Yes, please contact the Camp Manager to organise.
Do you supply dishwashing liquid?
We supply dishwashing liquid for the commercial washing machine but you must BYO brushes/dishwash/tea towels for hand washing
Do you supply toilet paper?
Yes
Can I pitch a tent?
Yes, the Camp Manager can show you where
Can I vape and smoke at the camp?
No, the camp is smoke and vape free. Everyone must go offsite to smoke or vape.
Do you have wifi and cell service available?
Wifi is connected in our hall, this will support up to 5 people and the password is given to the camp leader. One NZ Cell coverage is excellent, otherwise patchy for other providers.
Are camp fires allowed?
We have a designated area for our brazier to be used by campers, this is dependent on the fire season so best to check with the custodian prior to arrival. BYO wood.

Established in 1960
The land was gifted by Houghtons Bush Farm. Peaceful and private, the camp is set in an area of native forest about two kilometres inland from Muriwai Beach in West Auckland.
Purpose
Houghton's Bush Camp has been operating in the community for over 50 years.
We believe in the importance of providing an affordable and inclusive outdoor camping experience to enrich the lives of young New Zealanders and the wider community.
Availability
Houghton's Bush Camp is available to any group willing to accept the terms and conditions of use.
Bookings are essential and exclusive access is granted for the time of your stay.
Liability
Please contact our Customer Services Officer at bookings@presbyteriancamps.co.nz for a copy of our Terms and Conditions.
Ownership
Camp is owned and operated by the Presbyterian Church of Aotearoa New Zealand, and its services are administered by a board of volunteers. Camp management is provided by an onsite custodian. Houghton's Bush Presbyterian Camp Charitable Trust (registered charity CC53084) - GST #118-940-156
Charges
To confirm a stay, a booking deposit is required. For further pricing information, or to make a booking, please contact our Customer Service Officer to discuss your needs. Call +64 9 411 9191, or email bookings@presbyteriancamps.co.nz
Hunua Falls Camp
Hunua Falls Camp is our sister venue located next to the beautiful Hunua Falls. It is available for hire, please visit our site for this Camp.
